_what_this_is: Canonical board identity, answering PH09-022. Four generators each define what a board is, in four different shapes, and no two agree on the identifier. This is the one record they read instead.
_governing_constraint: THIS FILE RECORDS WHAT THE SLUGS AND NAMES ALREADY ARE. IT DOES NOT CHANGE ANY OF THEM. Every value below was read out of the current repo and is byte-identical to the literal it replaces. A slug is a live URL and GitHub Pages cannot issue a 301; a name is visible text, and visible text is never altered without explicit approval.
_why_slugs_and_names_are_maps: PH09's design made `slugs` a map because one board is spelled three ways across three families and all three are correct - the URLs are frozen. Measured on 2026-08-11, the same is true of GROUP NAMES, which PH09 did not anticipate: Theme 2 reaches published output as three different strings. `The UK Economy — Performance and Policies` (em dash) in taxonomy.json and the notes hub <h1>, `The UK Economy - Performance and Policies` (hyphen) in the flashcards decks, and `The UK Economy` in practice-questions. Collapsing those to one canonical name would silently rewrite visible text on a whole page family. So names are recorded per consumer too, and the differences are data rather than a bug to tidy.
_adding_a_board: Add an entry here, create the notes pages and source data, re-run the generators, add the nav entries in templates/header.html. `expectedTopics` keeps build_past_paper_taxonomy.py's loud-failure guard: a board whose data does not match its declaration fails rather than emitting a short taxonomy.

aqa._specCodesAreReal_why: AQA notes use site-local codes 1.x.y and 2.x.y, deliberately not the real 7136 codes 4.1.x and 4.2.x. Ratified in CLAUDE.md, do not 'fix' them. The consequence PH09-023 records is that this puts them in the same namespace as Edexcel's real codes: 37 of 129 codes are claimed by both boards with different meanings, so a spec code is never a key on its own. Always (board, spec).

_pastPapersOnly: Edexcel B and OCR have past papers on the site and no notes, no glossary, no flashcards and no question bank. They are not boards in this file's sense - nothing generates anything for them - and past-papers/edexcel-b/ and past-papers/ocr/ are hand-written pages. Recorded here so that their absence reads as a decision.
_notWiredInYet: Nothing imports this file. scripts/verify_boards.py asserts it reproduces all four hardcoded structures byte-for-byte, which is PH09's migration step 1: add the record, change nothing, prove equivalence. Repointing the generators is step 2 onwards and is a separate commit per generator, each verified by its output not moving.
